project_context.name: CleverFerret Universal Media Library
project_context.description: Android app for managing books, music, movies, and podcasts with Calibre integration
project_context.innovation: Universal Build System with automatic architecture detection and AAPT2 compatibility
project_context.target_users: Media enthusiasts who want to organize all their content in one app

ai_development_tips: Always use Universal Build System commands for building
Architecture detection is automatic - no manual configuration needed
AAPT2 compatibility issues are auto-resolved by the build system
All documentation is in docs/ directory
